thread:
jen.sales: OrionProof RFI just came in. They want a short POC plan that covers ingestion options, quantization impact on accuracy, a 2-week timeline, and commercial bullets. Doc uploaded: https://drive.company/orionproof_rfi.pdf. Can someone draft short pasteable lines?

ops-bot: Uploaded file `orionproof_rfi.pdf` (1.1MB) to #sales thread.

ash.eng: I can do the tech lines. Suggest 2-week POC: week 1 baseline (hosted fp16), week 2 quantized run (int8) on a Dedicated or burstable instance. Ingestion: presigned S3 URLs or cross-account role; presign recommended for one-off uploads. We'll provide a small eval harness and an example presign command.

mira.sec: Security: require DPA/BAA for PHI before ingestion. For hosted POC we support customer-managed KMS and 14-day artifact retention; audit logs retained 30 days. Presigned URLs must be read-only and rotated for multiple batches. For HSM/FIPS support require Private deployment + SOW. Contact mira.sec@redwood.ai for questionnaire clarifications.

pete.finance: Commercials: recommend POC credit $5,500 covering hosted eval and first 200GB egress. Dedicated short trial commit $12k/month (30-day min). Egress overage $0.13/GB. Support beyond included hours billed at $220/hr.

ash.eng: Paste-ready lines: 
- Ingestion: "Customer may upload via presigned S3 URLs (recommended, TTL 24h) or provide a cross-account read-only IAM role; we can provide Terraform snippets on request."
- Residency: "Hosted POC data stored in the selected cloud region; Private/VPC or on-prem deployments available for strict residency."
- KMS/HSM: "Customer-managed KMS supported for hosted POCs. HSM/FIPS-140 compliant key material available for Private/on-prem deployments via SOW."
- Retention: "Default POC artifacts retention: 14 days; audit logs retained 30 days. Shorter retention for sensitive data on request."
- Egress/billing: "POC covers first 200GB; additional egress billed at $0.13/GB. Private deployments follow customer cloud egress policies."

mira.sec: Minor edit: call out we require a signed DPA before any sample containing PII/PHI is ingested. Also add small note that presigned URLs should be scoped to objects and not bucket-wide permissions.

pete.finance: Final commercial sentence: "One-time POC credit $5.5k (covers hosted eval + first 200GB egress). Dedicated trial pricing starts at $12k/mo (30-day min). Overages at $0.13/GB."

jen.sales: Great. Can someone add a one-paragraph exec blurb I can paste at top of their RFI?

ash.eng: Exec blurb: "Redwood will run a focused 2-week POC with OrionProof: week 1 for hosted fp16 baseline and week 2 to demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs using quantized runtimes on Dedicated. We will measure latency (p50/p95), throughput, and embedding similarity against a customer-provided eval set and deliver a findings report with recommended serving configuration and cost estimates."

jen.sales: Perfect. I'll assemble and send the RFI response this afternoon. Thanks all :thumbsup:
